stages.text: 01 / Sign in or create a resident account. Fictional demonstration data.
02 / Create an account. No OTP verification is included in this MVP.
03 / Resident dashboard: report a concern and view recent activity.
04 / Required-field checks explain what needs to be corrected.
05 / Add concern details and location. Photos and GPS are optional.
06 / Review before submitting. Identity is withheld from the staff view.
07 / Edit details without losing the report draft.
08 / A saved report receives its own reference number.
09 / The resident can see the initial Received status.
10 / Staff sign in to a separate report-management workspace.
11 / Staff can read the concern; the anonymous reporter identity is hidden.
12 / Staff post an In progress update with a resident-visible note.
13 / Marking the concern Resolved keeps the earlier history.
14 / The resident sees the same status history after signing back in.
15 / Find a report by reference number and filter by status.
